images.name: factory-automation-remote-i-o

images.name: waste-water-plant
images.alt: Exterior of a municipal waste water treatment plant, with aeration basins and the operations building
images.review: clean: no legible brand; a person standing in the building's doorway is small, side-on and not recognizable at the delivered widths; cropped to roughly 4:3 to match the industries card, which is 4:3 and covers, so the whole frame is seen: the covered basin and its railings across the middle, the operations building filling the right, the aeration basin bottom right, and lawn only in the bottom-left corner. Four candidate crops were compared as thumbnails; the two that excluded the doorway figure had to cut the operations building in half, or drop it entirely, or fall under 800px wide, which would have made the two srcset files identical

images.name: soil-sampler

images.review: cropped to remove a parked car and its legible license plate from the left edge of frame; remaining cabinet interior is clean, no brand, no face

video.name: hero
video.review: 1080p shop-floor clip of a blue-framed multi-station automation machine with pneumatic slides and valve manifolds; reviewed all 29 s on a 1 s contact sheet plus full-resolution frames at 4 s and 14 s: only handwritten STATION tape labels, no supplier or customer name, no face; 0-8 s is the calmest window before the camera walks; stabilised with vidstab (5% zoom); poster is the sharpest frame in the window by Laplacian variance

video_alternate.name: hero
video_alternate.review: checked contact sheet at 5s steps (0 to 75s) plus a 1s-step pass over the 37-49s window; 39-47s holds the die-cutting head running behind its glass guard with the red laser guide line visible, generic tick-mark scale and unmarked control buttons only, no legible supplier or customer name, no face -- clean, chosen; footage is handheld so the loop itself carries motion blur throughout, but the poster frame at 41.0s scored highest on a Laplacian-variance sharpness pass over 39-47s at 0.25s steps (var 255 vs 195-219 for the runners-up), visibly crisper than the original 39.0s poster
video_alternate.note: previous hero; the die cutter loop, kept as a documented alternate
